title: Fabric API is read on every release
text: Before 1.19.2 Fabric's maven publishes fabric-api as an empty parent jar, each module a separate artifact, so the link check, the route map and the port read no Fabric API on any Fabric update before it: Fabric API breaks were never seen, and calls into Fabric API that moved were never followed. The build was also chosen by name (+1.16), which gives a family, not the releases a build runs on: 1.16 was checked against 0.42.0+1.16, which needs 1.16.2, while the game ran another build. Exposure.fabricApi now takes the newest build of the release's family whose own fabric.mod.json accepts the release and whose code names no game class the release lacks, read as players have it: the maven jar from 1.19.2, Fabric's own Modrinth file of that build before. The link check, the route map, the port and the game a port starts in all read that one jar, and the route map names it per release.
finish: Every Fabric update reads a Fabric API with its modules; old updates count Fabric API breaks; Totally Lit's 1.15.2 -> 1.16 port either loads in game or is reported, never counted while it crashes
wrongIf: a mod reported on a Fabric API member loads in game on the release's Fabric API, or a mod that links fails in game on a Fabric API member
result: Every Fabric update now reads Fabric API; on 1.15.2 -> 1.16, 1.16.5 -> 1.17 and 1.18.2 -> 1.19 the link check sees 118, 124 and 22 broken Fabric API uses where it saw 0, and the 1.15.2 -> 1.16 route map follows 963 Fabric API members where it had none. Cloud scoreboard 45173894954 against main 4dd95cb: every update 6,709 -> 6,705 (13 false links caught, 9 mods freed), big updates 2,547 -> 2,541, newest game 24 -> 24; all changes are Fabric updates before 1.21.1. Caught: Compressed Blocks and GrowableOres (FabricItemSettings, which no Fabric API that runs on 1.16 has), crashexploitfixer (a mixin into NetworkingImpl, gone on 1.16), CIT Resewn and spark (ClientCommandManager.DISPATCHER on 1.19), and seven more on 1.18, 1.18.2, 1.19.1 and 1.19.2. In game (cloud-load 45168999181, 54 mods of 1.15.2 -> 1.16 against main's receipt): Totally Lit, which main counted and which crashed on FabricBlockSettings.copyOf(Block), is now ported to Fabric API's own copyOf(BlockBehaviour) and loads on a 1.16 server and client; every other mod's verdict is the same except crashexploitfixer, now reported. Choosing the build took three tries, each disproved by a real start: Fabric API's own declared range alone took 0.14.2 for 1.16, which declares 1.16 and fails to start there (it needs 1.16.1's class_5414); Modrinth's release tags gave 1.15 the early 0.4.24 though 0.28.5+1.15 starts on 1.15; looking only at builds named for the release or its parent gave 26.1.1 an older Fabric API than 26.1 and broke 6 mods there. The final pick starts a bare server on 1.15, 1.16, 1.18, 1.19.1, 1.20, 1.21 and 26.1.1. The 1.14.4 -> 1.15 game run gave no per-mod verdicts: mods built for Java 17 and 21 crash every start on 1.15's Java 8. Left: a mod's use of Fabric API behind an isModLoaded check of another mod counts as a break (More Mobs, behind MidnightLib), as a game member there does.
